editorial.blurb: Laimoon brings vibrant Mediterranean flavors to the Loop with customizable bowls, standout gyro-spiced burgers, and generously portioned plates that balance spice and freshness.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the weekday lunch rush—despite long lines, service moves fast, and you'll catch the make-your-own bowl at its freshest, where you can mix two base options and layer unique, flavorful toppings.
signatureDishes: Gyro-spiced beef burger with whipped feta and caramelized onion
Make-your-own steak bowl with preserved lemon sauce
